response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and polyglot development skills with a focus on testability and open-source contributions. However, his experience lacks depth in C++ and large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, which are critical for this role. His leadership and mentoring experience is present but not explicitly tied to cloud or DevOps engineering.
strengths: Extensive experience in software design, architecture, and mentoring across multiple domains (web, mobile, embedded).
Proven track record of leading open-source projects (e.g., GISCollective) and establishing engineering best practices (TDD, CI/CD).
Diverse technical background with exposure to distributed systems, real-time data processing, and low-latency applications.
concerns: Only ~1 year of C++ experience (at National Instruments), far below the 8-year requirement.
Limited explicit experience with cloud compute platforms or production-level cloud architecture.
Technical leadership roles have not focused on cloud/DevOps teams or internal compute platforms.
